## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
- Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, which is double-counting refunds. Tenacity refactor is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Payment API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded and shut down. Models use `DeclarativeBase`; `declarative_base()` is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Disabling idempotency middleware: caused duplicate staging invoices.
- Local decimal rendering: omitted locale grouping.
- Repeating table headers: caused three-page output.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Investigate `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py` refund aggregation.
- [pending] Add regression test and fix.
- [pending] Run targeted and full tests; next command: `pytest -q tests/jobs/test_reconcile.py` (status unknown).

## Recent work
Added request-aware structured logging and passed `pytest -q tests/api/test_health.py` (4 passed). A scheduler DST test remains unresolved.
